title: Monthly customer rebate calculation
summary: Each month the sales extract is converted into euros, totalled per customer, and matched to a rebate tier to work out what each customer has earned. The finance lead then reviews the list, enters any adjustment, and signs off the ones they are happy with.

steps.title: Open the sales extract
steps.explanation: Start from the monthly sales extract, which lists every customer's sales in their own currency.

reads.label: Monthly sales by customer
reads.why: It is the only record of what each customer bought.

assumptions: The extract is refreshed before the rebate run.

steps.title: Convert every sale to euros
steps.explanation: Convert each sale into euros using the exchange rate for that customer's currency.

reads.label: Sales value and currency
reads.why: The amount to convert and which rate applies.

reads.label: Exchange rates
reads.why: Holds the rate to euros for each currency.

assumptions: One rate per currency for the whole month, not a daily rate.

steps.title: Total the euro sales per customer
steps.explanation: Add up all the euro sales belonging to each customer.

reads.label: Customer name
reads.why: The key the totals are grouped by.

steps.title: Find each customer's rebate tier
steps.explanation: Look up which rebate band each customer's total falls into, and take the rate for that band.

reads.label: Total euro sales
reads.why: The value being matched against the bands.

reads.label: Rebate bands and rates
reads.why: Holds the threshold and rate for each band.

assumptions: Bands are cumulative for the period, as the notes sheet says.

steps.title: Work out the rebate earned
steps.explanation: Multiply each customer's total by their rebate rate.

reads.label: Rebate rate
reads.why: The other half of the calculation.

steps.title: Review, adjust and sign off
steps.explanation: You go through the list yourself, put in an adjustment where something needs correcting, and sign off the ones you are happy with.
assumptions: Both fields are typed in by hand; neither has a formula, and both are only partly filled.
unknowns: What makes you decide an adjustment is needed — is it always a credit or dispute, or are there other reasons?
Does a rebate still get paid if nobody has signed it off?
Some rows have no approver and no adjustment. Are those still outstanding, or deliberately left blank?

steps.title: Add the adjustment to get the final figure
steps.explanation: Add whatever adjustment you entered to the calculated rebate to get the amount actually paid.

reads.label: Manual adjustment
reads.why: Added on where one was entered; treated as nothing when blank.

openQuestions: What makes you decide a rebate needs an adjustment?
Does an unsigned rebate still get paid?
Are the rebate bands cumulative for the quarter, or per month?
